connector.name: Freeport Nostr
connector.registryDescription: Search Freeport Nostr events by kind, tag & geohash radius (rides, services, reputation).
connector.summary: Hosted at nostr-mcp.trinh.uk over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package freeport-nostr-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ptrinh account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
